criteria.evidence: Nine live fetches through the real Mercari search endpoint via the local scraper stack (Azurite + AIOWebScraper Functions host + ScraperWorker, off-screen Chromium confirmed via Get-CimInstance Win32_Process showing --window-position=-32000,-32000 on every launched chrome.exe), read back from Azurite's on-disk blob store (the Functions API itself requires SAS/account-key auth for blob reads, which HttpScrapeClient's BlobScrapeContentStore performs but a manual curl does not, so the raw azurite-data/__blobstorage__ extent files were read directly using their recorded byte offsets from __azurite_db_blob__.json). One of the nine fetches (the first unfiltered attempt) landed on a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge page and was retried once successfully, consistent with docs/running-locally.md's ~1-in-3 rate. All processes started for this (azurite, func, ScraperWorker, and every Chromium/node child they spawned) were stopped afterward and confirmed absent via Get-Process/Get-CimInstance; the S: drive substitution was removed with subst S: /D.
